# Local Online Marketing: 21 Strategies (2026)

Local online marketing uses online channels to drive foot traffic to your retail store. Here are 21 of the best tactics to try.

![](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0070/7032/files/Elise_Dopson.webp?v=1781546812)

[by Elise Dopson](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/authors/elise-dopson)9 Sept 2025 • 14 min read

![Light blue cube centered on a transparent cylindrical pedestal with a glowing ring](https://cdn.shopify.com/b/shopify-brochure2-assets/fc90f7f72ba08fb3c92c2f62e3ebfdb0.jpg?originalWidth=1848&originalHeight=782)

It’s rare for shoppers to visit your retail store by chance. [Over three-quarters](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/76-of-consumers-look-at-online-presence-before-physically-visiting-a-business-301272462.html) of them have already looked at your online presence before they set foot in your store. 

Shoppers consult reviews, browse ecommerce websites, and check product specifications so that when they arrive in-store, they have at least some idea of what they’d like to buy.

Local digital marketing helps you reach these touchpoints in the customer journey. Whether you pay to be there or maximize your chances of showing up organically, [local marketing](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-marketing) has the potential to drive a substantial amount of foot traffic to your store.

But with so many options available, it can be difficult to know where to start. This guide shares 21 local marketing ideas to get the most value out of the channels available to you. 

## 21 local online marketing strategies 

1.  [Create geo-targeted landing pages](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#1)
2.  [Optimize your website for local search terms](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#2)
3.  [Claim and optimize your Google Business profile](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#3)
4.  [Build local citations](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#4)
5.  [Encourage customer reviews](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#5)
6.  [Run local PPC campaigns](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#6)
7.  [Advertise on Google Maps](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#7)
8.  [Collect customer data from social media](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#8)
9.  [Tag your location in posts](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#9)
10.  [Partner with local influencers](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#10)
11.  [Encourage user-generated content](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#11)
12.  [Send local email marketing campaigns](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#12)
13.  [Offer online-to-offline promotions](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#13)
14.  [Send location-based push notifications](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#14)
15.  [Offer buy online, pickup in-store](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#15)
16.  [Leverage Shopify Managed Markets](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#16)
17.  [Implement an omnichannel loyalty program](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#17)
18.  [Host local events](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#18)
19.  [Collaborate with local business owners](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#19)
20.  [Pursue local press](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#20)
21.  [Use Shopify analytics](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-online-marketing#21)

## 1\. Create geo-targeted landing pages

Geo-targeted landing pages are specifically designed and optimized for visitors from a particular city, region, or neighborhood. These pages typically include location-specific content such as:

*   The store’s local address, phone number, and hours
*   Local promotions or events
*   Maps and directions
*   Customer reviews from that area
*   Keywords tied to that location (e.g., "bike store in Austin, TX")

If you operate multiple locations, develop separate pages for each area you serve (e.g., “/cityname/”) to show localized content and capture area-specific search traffic. This makes it easier for online shoppers to find what they need quickly, such as their nearby store, opening hours, or pickup options, without wading through your entire site. 

### 2\. Optimize your website for local search terms

Around [four in five US consumers](https://www.brightlocal.com/resources/local-seo-statistics/) search online for local businesses on a weekly basis. Almost a third search for them daily. Local search engine optimization (SEO) increases the chances of your site appearing in these local searches. 

The fundamentals of [local SEO](https://www.shopify.com/pk/blog/local-seo-retail) include:

# Digital Marketing for Local Businesses

Use **digital marketing** to help your local business get discovered by nearby customers, build trust, generate leads, increase enquiries and grow sales.

Whether you own a restaurant, retail store, salon, clinic, real estate business, educational institute, professional service or another local business, your customers are increasingly using search engines, maps, social media and websites to find businesses like yours.

[Explore Local Strategy](https://creatorspk.com/digital-marketing-for-local-businesses.php#strategy) [Explore Marketing Channels](https://creatorspk.com/digital-marketing-for-local-businesses.php#channels)

## Local Growth Checklist

*   Google Business Profile
*   Local SEO
*   Mobile-friendly website
*   Customer reviews
*   Social media marketing
*   Lead generation

## What Is Digital Marketing for Local Businesses?

**Digital marketing for local businesses** is the process of promoting a business through online channels to reach potential customers within a specific geographic area.

Unlike broad online marketing campaigns that may target audiences across an entire country or worldwide, local digital marketing focuses on attracting customers who are located near a business or searching for products and services within a particular city, neighborhood or service area.

A local digital marketing strategy can include **Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, website SEO, social media marketing, content marketing, online reviews, paid advertising and lead generation.**

The objective is not simply to generate website traffic. The objective is to connect your business with people who are most likely to visit your location, call your business, request a quote, make an appointment or purchase your products and services.

WHY IT MATTERS

## Why Digital Marketing Is Important for Local Businesses

Customers often search online before deciding where to buy, eat, visit, book or contact. A strong digital presence helps your business become visible during these important moments.
